name: Sentul Pavilion KL
description: Sentul Pavillion is the one of the latest event spaces under the management of YTL group. Nestled within a private park adjacent to the better known Sentul Depot, it’s a short drive from the city. Constructed as a glasshouse overlooking the landscaped vistas and tastefully finished with 5 star amenities, this place is perfect for couples looking to have an upscale event to remember. As your guests arrive, they will be rewarded with a scenic drive through this well planned park. The walkway from the carpark to the entrance of the pavilion was designed to fit a buggy car if one was needed.

name: Epitro House
description:
Epitro House is a spacious urban architectural detached house nestled among the bustling Petaling Jaya, right at the heart of Klang Valley. With towering trees surrounding the property, and a drive-through pavement ensuring ease of traffic for your guests, along with a maximum capacity of 25 parking bays, it offers convenience like no other houses. 
​
Admire the floor to ceiling glass panelling, with an internal double storey entrance air-well, ensuring that the space is continually basked with the natural warmth of sunlight. It is the perfect setting for a lasting impression today!

name: Grand Hyatt Kuala Lumpur
description:
Grand Hyatt Kuala Lumpur, located in the vicinity of the iconic Petronas Twin Towers, is one of the most popular hotel venue for weddings, this is due to its high capacity; the Grand Ballroom with 700 pax, and the Grand Salon with maximum capacity of 450 pax. Wedding packages start from RM455 nett per person as of the date of publication.

The oval-shaped, pillar-free Grand Ballroom and Grand Salon are dazzling options for gala events, especially weddings, thanks to their energy-efficient crystal chandeliers and their most recent instalment – LED screens that cover 360 of the ballroom, easily transforming a space to match your wedding theme. On the other hand, the Grand Residence, with its capacity of 20-330 guests, is a welcoming and functional entertainment space that is ideal for product launches and art exhibitions, or events such as exclusive meetings and cocktail receptions.

Grand Hyatt KL also features 412 guestrooms, including 42 suites, and three exciting dining options: THIRTY8 offers a selection of steaks, seafood, sushi and sashimi; JP Teres serves the best of Malaysian cuisine; and Poolside features healthy international and local favourites.

name: The Majestic Hotel Kuala Lumpur
description:
The Majestic Hotel Kuala Lumpur, with its blend of colonial elegance and modern luxury, presents an ideal venue for weddings. Its historical charm and sophisticated ambiance, rooted in the 1930s architecture, provide a romantic and timeless setting. The hotel offers elegant event spaces that can be tailored to fit the specific needs of a wedding, whether it's a grand affair or an intimate gathering.

The hotel's culinary expertise is a highlight, offering a range of dining options that can be customized for wedding receptions. From fine dining experiences to local culinary delights, the Majestic Hotel ensures a memorable gastronomic journey for the wedding party and guests.

Additionally, the hotel's strategic location in the heart of Kuala Lumpur adds convenience for guests, providing easy access to the city's attractions and amenities. The luxurious accommodations and top-notch services at the Majestic Hotel Kuala Lumpur make it a preferred choice for couples seeking a blend of historical elegance and contemporary luxury for their special day.

name: Hilton Kuala Lumpur
description:
Hilton Kuala Lumpur is a premier wedding venue known for its luxurious amenities and excellent service. It boasts elegant ballrooms and event spaces that can be customized for weddings of any size and style, all equipped with modern facilities. The hotel excels in its catering services, offering a diverse range of menu options to suit different dietary needs and preferences, prepared by a skilled culinary team. Additionally, the hotel provides comfortable and well-appointed accommodations for guests and the wedding party, enhancing the overall experience of the celebration.

Strategically located in the heart of Kuala Lumpur, the venue offers easy accessibility and proximity to various city attractions, making it a convenient choice for guests, especially those traveling from afar. Hilton Kuala Lumpur also offers additional services such as floral arrangements, photography, and entertainment, supported by an experienced event planning team to ensure a seamless and memorable wedding. Their customizable wedding packages, designed to cater to a variety of needs and budgets, further underscore the venue's commitment to providing a unique and unforgettable wedding experience.

name: The Saujana Hotel Kuala Lumpur
description: The Saujana Hotel Kuala Lumpur is a distinguished 5-star resort-style hotel located in Malaysia. Nestled within 160 hectares of expansive tropical forests and gardens, the hotel boasts a serene lakeside view, creating a picturesque setting for both business and leisure activities. The name "Saujana" is derived from the old Malay expression 'sejauh di sana', meaning 'as far as the eye can see', aptly describing the vast and beautiful landscape surrounding the property. The resort encompasses 355 well-appointed rooms and is notable for featuring two adjoining 18-hole championship golf courses, making it an ideal destination for golf enthusiasts. Additionally, it offers an outdoor pool and spa treatments, further enhancing the luxury experience for its guests. The rooms are designed with modern decor and are equipped with high-definition flat-screen TVs, minibars, and iPod docks, ensuring a comfortable and convenient stay. The Saujana Hotel Kuala Lumpur's prestigious status is further highlighted by its recognition as the third venue outside Europe to be honored with the European Tour Destination in 2015

name: Pavilion Hotel Kuala Lumpur
description:
Pavilion Hotel Kuala Lumpur, managed by Banyan Tree, is situated in the heart of Kuala Lumpur's vibrant Bukit Bintang area. This location places it at the center of a bustling business and entertainment district, surrounded by a plethora of attractions, dining options, and shopping experiences​​​​​​. The hotel is uniquely positioned atop the Pavilion Mega shopping mall, offering easy access to a wide range of shopping options, from luxury boutiques to budget-friendly stores, as well as a variety of local and international cuisines. Additionally, the hotel is conveniently close to the Jalan Alor night street market, known for its abundant street dining options​​.

The hotel is known for its understated warmth, impeccable service, and unmatched experience in this tropical metropolis​​​​. It features 325 spaciously appointed rooms and suites, along with an elegant, pillar-less ballroom and six multi-event spaces, all bathed in natural daylight​​. Pavilion Hotel Kuala Lumpur provides a range of on-site amenities to enhance the guest experience. These include an infinity pool offering breathtaking views, a state-of-the-art Sky Gym for fitness enthusiasts, a dedicated Kid's Club for children's entertainment, and a luxurious Club Lounge offering exclusive privileges. Dining options at the hotel include a pork-free Chinese restaurant, an all-day dining restaurant, and a speakeasy bar, catering to a variety of tastes and preferences​​​​.

name: The St. Regis Kuala Lumpur
description: St. Regis Kuala Lumpur, a beacon of luxury and elegance, presents an unparalleled destination for your special day. Nestled in the heart of Malaysia's vibrant capital, this exquisite venue combines timeless sophistication with modern opulence, making it a perfect setting for a wedding. The hotel's grand architecture and sumptuous interiors, inspired by the rich heritage and culture of Kuala Lumpur, provide a breathtaking backdrop for ceremonies and receptions. The St. Regis Kuala Lumpur boasts an array of stunning ballrooms and event spaces, each meticulously designed to offer a sense of grandeur and intimacy. The Astor Ballroom, in particular, is a masterpiece of design, featuring magnificent crystal chandeliers and state-of-the-art lighting systems, setting a romantic and majestic atmosphere for your nuptials.

name: Le Meridien Kuala Lumpur
description:
Le Meridien Kuala Lumpur, a beacon of contemporary luxury in the heart of Malaysia's bustling capital, presents an exquisite destination for couples dreaming of an unforgettable wedding. Nestled amidst the vibrant cityscape, this hotel combines modern elegance with world-class hospitality, making it an ideal choice for a wedding that balances urban sophistication with intimate charm. The hotel's prime location offers easy access to Kuala Lumpur's key attractions, providing a perfect backdrop for both local and destination weddings. Its grand ballrooms and event spaces, characterized by their sleek design and flexible layouts, cater to celebrations of all sizes, from intimate gatherings to lavish affairs. The culinary team at Le Meridien excels in crafting bespoke menus, ensuring a dining experience that complements the unique spirit of each wedding.

Beyond the allure of its facilities, Le Meridien Kuala Lumpur is renowned for its impeccable service, ensuring that every aspect of a wedding is executed with precision and grace. The dedicated wedding planners at the hotel work tirelessly to bring each couple's vision to life, paying attention to the smallest details to create a seamless and stress-free experience. From the initial planning stages to the final toast, couples can expect personalized attention and expertise. The hotel also offers luxurious accommodations and amenities, providing a serene retreat for the couple and their guests. With its fusion of contemporary luxury and a deep understanding of the cultural nuances of Malaysian weddings, Le Meridien Kuala Lumpur stands as a distinguished venue that promises a wedding celebration as memorable and unique as the love it honors.

name: JW Marriott Hotel Kuala Lumpur
description:
JW Marriott Kuala Lumpur, nestled in the heart of the bustling city, offers an exceptional blend of luxury and convenience, making it an ideal destination for your dream wedding. Renowned for its elegant and sophisticated ambiance, the hotel boasts a stunning array of venues, each designed to cater to weddings of every scale and style. From the opulent Starhill Ballroom, perfect for grand and lavish celebrations, to more intimate spaces for smaller, cozy gatherings, JW Marriott Kuala Lumpur ensures every wedding is an unforgettable experience. The hotel's central location, right in the midst of Kuala Lumpur's vibrant shopping and entertainment district, adds to its allure, providing easy access for guests and endless opportunities for magnificent wedding photography.

At JW Marriott Kuala Lumpur, every detail is meticulously curated to create the perfect wedding day. The hotel's dedicated team of wedding specialists offers personalized service, ensuring that each aspect of your celebration - from exquisite catering options featuring a range of international and local cuisines, to elegant floral arrangements and decor - is tailored to your preferences. The culinary team's exceptional skills promise to tantalize your guests' taste buds, making the dining experience a highlight of your special day. With its combination of outstanding service, luxurious accommodations, and a prime location, JW Marriott Kuala Lumpur stands out as a premier wedding venue, promising to transform your wedding dreams into a beautiful reality.

name: The Ruma Hotel and Residences
description:
Nestled in the heart of Kuala Lumpur, The Ruma Hotel and Residences emerges as a beacon of contemporary luxury and a haven for those seeking an exceptional wedding venue. This hotel is not just a place to stay; it's a sanctuary where sophistication meets comfort. The architectural design, inspired by Kuala Lumpur's rich cultural heritage, merges gracefully with modern elements, creating an ambiance that is both elegant and inviting. Each space within The Ruma is thoughtfully designed, from the plush, luxurious rooms offering breathtaking views of the city skyline to the exquisite dining areas, ensuring a memorable experience for every guest.

The Ruma Hotel and Residences stands out as an idyllic location for weddings, offering a blend of impeccable service, stunning decor, and culinary excellence. The hotel's grand ballroom, adorned with tasteful interiors and state-of-the-art facilities, provides a splendid backdrop for both intimate and lavish wedding celebrations. Couples can expect personalized service with attention to every detail, from bespoke menu planning by culinary experts to exquisite floral arrangements, ensuring their special day is as flawless and unique as their love story. With its central location, The Ruma also offers easy access for guests, making it not just a venue, but a seamless part of an unforgettable wedding experience.

name: Sime Darby Convention Centre
description:
Sime Darby Convention Centre, nestled in the heart of Kuala Lumpur, and located within the proximity of the prestigious Kuala Lumpur Golf & Country Club,  presents an idyllic setting for a dream wedding. This prestigious venue, surrounded by the lush greenery of Bukit Kiara, offers a serene and picturesque backdrop, perfect for capturing the beauty and essence of your special day. The centre is renowned for its state-of-the-art facilities and spacious halls, capable of accommodating both intimate gatherings and grand celebrations. Its elegant architecture, coupled with modern amenities, provides a sophisticated and luxurious atmosphere, ensuring a memorable experience for the couple and their guests.

What truly sets Sime Darby Convention Centre apart is its commitment to providing exceptional service. The dedicated team of professional wedding planners is adept at tailoring services to meet the unique needs of each couple, ensuring every detail is meticulously handled. From exquisite culinary offerings crafted by experienced chefs to customizable décor options that transform spaces into a magical setting, the centre excels at creating a personalized and enchanting wedding experience. Whether you desire a traditional, contemporary, or culturally themed wedding, Sime Darby Convention Centre is equipped to bring your vision to life, making it an ideal choice for couples seeking a blend of elegance, exclusivity, and impeccable service for their wedding day.

name: EQ Kuala Lumpur
description:
EQ Hotel Kuala Lumpur, situated in the heart of Malaysia's vibrant capital, stands as a modern marvel, blending luxury with contemporary elegance. This iconic hotel, with its sleek architecture and panoramic views of the city skyline, including the iconic Petronas Twin Towers, offers an unparalleled experience for couples seeking the perfect wedding venue. Renowned for its exceptional service and state-of-the-art facilities, EQ Hotel presents a range of exquisite ballrooms and event spaces that can be transformed to match the dream theme of any couple. Whether it's an intimate gathering or a grand celebration, the hotel's dedicated team of wedding specialists ensures every detail is meticulously crafted to create an unforgettable experience.

The allure of EQ Hotel Kuala Lumpur extends beyond its stunning aesthetics and prime location. It is an oasis of culinary excellence, offering a diverse array of dining options that cater to every palate, making it an ideal choice for wedding banquets. From traditional Malaysian flavors to international cuisines, the hotel's chefs are adept at creating bespoke menus that add a unique touch to each wedding celebration. The hotel's luxurious accommodations ensure a comfortable stay for the wedding party and guests, with rooms and suites offering breathtaking views and modern amenities. EQ Hotel Kuala Lumpur is not just a venue; it's a destination where wedding dreams come to life amidst the backdrop of one of Asia's most dynamic cities.

name: Sheraton Petaling Jaya Hotel
description:
Nestled in the vibrant heart of Petaling Jaya, the Sheraton Petaling Jaya Hotel stands as a beacon of luxury and sophistication, making it an ideal venue for your dream wedding. This prestigious hotel, with its stunning architecture and elegant décor, offers a blend of contemporary style and traditional charm, perfect for creating a memorable wedding experience. The grand ballroom, adorned with crystal chandeliers and state-of-the-art lighting, sets a majestic backdrop for both intimate and grand wedding celebrations. The hotel's versatile event spaces can be customized to match your wedding theme, ensuring every detail reflects your personal style and vision.

Beyond the exquisite event spaces, the Sheraton Petaling Jaya Hotel prides itself on providing exceptional service and attention to detail. The dedicated wedding planners at Sheraton are committed to crafting bespoke wedding experiences, from exquisite floral arrangements to gourmet catering options that tantalize the taste buds. Couples can indulge in a culinary journey with customized menus, featuring a fusion of local and international cuisines prepared by expert chefs. Moreover, the hotel's luxurious accommodations and amenities offer a serene retreat for the couple and their guests, ensuring a comfortable and enjoyable stay. With its prime location, elegant ambiance, and unparalleled service, the Sheraton Petaling Jaya Hotel is more than just a venue; it's a destination where wedding dreams come to life.

name: Sunway Resort Hotel
description:
Sunway Resort Hotel, nestled in the heart of the vibrant Sunway City, presents itself as an idyllic destination for a fairy-tale wedding. This luxurious hotel, surrounded by the breathtaking skyline of Kuala Lumpur, offers a blend of urban sophistication and comfort, making it an ideal location for couples seeking a memorable wedding experience. The resort's grand architecture, coupled with its lush landscaping and serene water features, creates a majestic backdrop for both indoor and outdoor ceremonies. With an array of stunning ballrooms, including the opulent Grand Lagoon Ballroom, Sunway Resort Hotel caters to weddings of all sizes, from intimate gatherings to lavish celebrations. The hotel's team of experienced wedding planners and chefs are dedicated to personalizing each event, ensuring every detail reflects the couple's unique style and preferences.

Beyond the elegant venues, Sunway Resort Hotel is renowned for its exceptional service, offering a seamless and stress-free experience for the bridal couple and their guests. The culinary team prides itself on crafting exquisite menus that range from traditional local delicacies to international cuisine, guaranteeing a gastronomic delight for all palates. The hotel's luxurious accommodation options, including sumptuous bridal suites, provide the perfect retreat for the couple and their guests. Additionally, the hotel's proximity to Sunway City's array of attractions, including shopping malls, theme parks, and entertainment centers, makes it an excellent choice for guests seeking a weekend getaway. Sunway Resort Hotel is not just a venue; it's a destination where every wedding becomes a cherished memory.

name: Metal Bees
description: Metal Bees is complemented by two distinct reception areas — one with exposed brick walls, steel accents, and floor-to-ceiling glass panels; the other with cement flooring, a large window, and a sliding glass door that opens to a private patio. Whether you’re hosting a stylish soirée or a grand celebration, Metal Bees sets the stage for impactful, unforgettable events. Choosing them for your wedding means stepping into a world where your imagination can roam free.

name: W Kuala Lumpur
description: Modern skyline dominated by the magnificent Petronas Twin Towers is W Kuala Lumpur. Connecting a world of limitless luxury experiences and inspiring audacious lifestyles to globetrotters, our hotel in Kuala Lumpur features stylish, vibrant rooms and suites with signature W amenities. Take a culinary journey and dine at Flock, with its specially curated Pan-Asian grill menu, or YEN for modern Chinese cuisine with fusion twists. Be seen at the best rooftop bar - WET Deck; with stunning skyline views. Discover the allure and glam up your evenings at LIVING ROOM. Unwind and recharge at Away Spa. Within close proximity with Kuala Lumpur's best attractions, we are Vibrant, Welcoming and Exclusive there for you Whatever/Whenever©

name: Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur
description: With two well-lit, modern ballrooms and a variety of intimate salons and private spaces, we offer ideal settings for a wedding venue in Kuala Lumpur. All of our venues are conveniently located on the same event floor, offering numerous options for your ceremony, cocktail hour and reception. Whether you're looking for a wedding reception site, banquet hall or intimate ceremony venue in Kuala Lumpur, our versatile spaces can meet all your needs.

name: Crystal Crown Hotel PJ
description:
This modern hotel in the business district is 13 minutes' walk from Asia Jaya light rail station, 5 km from Mid Valley Megamall and 15 km from the iconic PETRONAS Twin Towers.
Airy rooms feature high ceilings and wood floors, as well as flat-screen TVs, free Wi-Fi, minifridges, and tea and coffeemaking facilities. Upgraded rooms have access to an executive lounge with evening snacks; suites add separate sitting areas.
There's an alcohol-free cafe serving regional and international fare. Other amenities include a fitness centre, an outdoor pool, a Jacuzzi and a sauna.

name: Shangri-La Kuala Lumpur
description: Experience the perfect blend of luxury and warmth in the heart of Kuala Lumpur. Whether you're here for business or leisure, Shangri-La Kuala Lumpur offers an elegant urban retreat with world-class hospitality. Indulge in exquisite dining, unwind in lush greenery, and enjoy seamless convenience at our iconic city hotel.

name: The Estate KL
description: A timeless landmark in the heart of Kuala Lumpur, where history meets modernity. The Estate on Federal Hill offers a sanctuary for culture, history, and inspiration. Experience a place where every visit becomes part of the legacy.

name: The Chow Kit – An Ormond Hotel
description: The Chow Kit – An Ormond Hotelrethinks the notion of luxury for the contemporary traveller. We believe that the greatest luxury is a life lived with comfort, purpose and balance - the sense that you are not bothered with frivolity, but focused on what matters most. Editing out what is unnecessary and keeping the essentials, is simplified luxury. Located in the bustling heart of old Kuala Lumpur, The Chow Kit is a traveller’s sanctuary, but not only just for rest - also for exploration and inspiration.

name: M Resort & Hotel
description: M Resort & Hotel is a well-connected luxurious escape conveniently nestled in the green belt of Damansara – a suburban area of Kuala Lumpur. A lifestyle hotel inspired by local cultures; designed to connect you to authentic experiences, this picturesque hotel offers unique views of one of the city’s renowned green areas – the Kelab Golf Perkhidmatan Awam (KGPA) and seamlessly combine value with comfort, personalised intuitive service, exquisite accommodations, culinary excellence as well as spectacular spas for urban elites and business travellers.

name: Aloft Kuala Lumpur Sentral
description: Relax & recharge at Aloft Kuala Lumpur Sentral, our Kuala Lumpur Sentral Station hotel offering savvy rooms and loft-inspired suites, signature platform beds, and Camp Aloft for your little ones. Explore KL with convenient access to the main transportation hub at KL Sentral station. Chill out by our outdoor pool with views of Kuala Lumpur's cityscape or enjoy a workout session at Re:charge℠ fitness center. Mix & match your meals at Re: fuel℠ by Aloft or be the host with the most from more than 11,500 square feet of event space. When the day is nearly done, retreat to hotel rooms and suites that capture the city's undeniable energy. Welcome to Aloft Kuala Lumpur Sentral, where exceptional stays are the

name: The Westin Kuala Lumpur
description: Thrive at our hotel in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Discover wellness and enrichment from a premium hotel room or suite at The Westin Kuala Lumpur, featuring White Tea Bath and Body products, and Westin Heavenly Beds. Fuel your day with fresh food items at our all-day restaurant The Living Room, cocktails at 443 Bar Lounge, or scenic offerings at our poolside restaurant and bar, Splash. Meetings, weddings, and social affairs are elevated in dynamic event spaces and after a busy day of meetings or sightseeing in the Golden Triangle of Bukit Bintang, refresh in an outdoor pool or exercise in our WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio. At The Westin Kuala Lumpur, your well-being comes first and foremost.

name: Grand Millennium KL
description: Millennium Hotels and Resorts is a Hong Leong subsidiary of Singapore-listed global real estate company City Developments Limited (CDL). Headquartered in Singapore, Millennium Hotels and Resorts is Singapore’s largest homegrown operator of international hotel brands spanning 4 continents and 80 strategic destinations. With a portfolio that includes timeless masterpieces to lifestyle properties, Millennium Hotels and Resorts comprises of the brands: The Biltmore, Grand Millennium, Millennium, M Social, Studio M, M Hotel, Copthorne and Kingsgate. The group also has a specially curated selection of uniquely inimitable properties under Leng’s Collection, which has been put together by our chairman, Mr. Kwek Leng Beng.

name: Crowne Plaza Kuala Lumpur City Centre
description:
Experience the pulsating heart of Kuala Lumpur with a stay at Crowne Plaza Kuala Lumpur City Centre. Our prime location places you steps from embassies, chic eateries, shopping districts, the city's vibrant nightlife, and iconic landmarks like the Petronas Twin Towers and KL Convention Centre.

Designed for discerning travellers, our versatile meeting spaces include a rainforest-themed ballroom and state-of-the-art facilities with complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi. With MRT and LRT stations just a 10-minute walk away, exploring the city is effortless.

After a dynamic day, retreat to our rooftop infinity pool, where breathtaking skyline views offer a moment of tranquillity. Savour an enticing mix of local delicacies and global favourites at Merchants, our all-day dining restaurant. For a refined culinary experience, Le Midi, our award-winning French Brasserie, Bar & Terrace, presents exquisite French cuisine to delight your palate.

Sustainability is at the core of our hospitality, with eco-friendly practices recognised by the Green Building Index (GBI) certification. From energy-efficient designs to sustainable operations, we are committed to reducing our environmental footprint while delivering an unparalleled guest experience.

Welcome to Crowne Plaza Kuala Lumpur City Centre – your premium destination for business and leisure in the heart of Kuala Lumpur.

name: Corus Hotel Kuala Lumpur
description: Corus KLCC is your gateway to the best of Kuala Lumpur. Just a short walk away, you’ll find the iconic Petronas Twin Towers, the Bukit Bintang shopping district, and the bustling Chinatown. Our convenient location also provides easy access to public transportation, making it simple to explore the city’s many attractions.

name: Angsana Teluk Bahang
description:
Welcome to Angsana, where unforgettable moments are forged and cherished.

Lose yourself in the gentle embrace of the ocean, the majesty of mountains, or the awe-inspiring city skylines.

Discover a playground where possibilities abound, where every dream becomes a reality, and where the world is your canvas.

name: Ruang Rama PJ
description:
Strategically located in Petaling Jaya, Ruang Rama offers easy access for all guests, with direct links to the Federal Highway and a short walking distance from the Asia Jaya LRT station.

Beyond its convenient location, the venue accommodates all types of events. It offers the community a beautiful space to celebrate your special day.

name: K'Seena House
description:
K’Seena House (pronounced ke-si-na), situated in Kuang, Selangor is a 100-year-old heritage home with contemporary extensions that provides a spacious and beautiful setting for many different events such as weddings, meetings, presentations and workshops. The house comes with one bedroom and one guest room with adjoined bathroom, an impressive 24,000ft² luscious garden and a kitchen that opens up to the back of the house, providing the nice airy atmosphere.
K'Seena House also offers packages for private iftar sessions during Ramadhan and for Aidilfitri open houses, serving halal delectable Malay cuisines. K’Seena House is the perfect getaway place for a total relaxation, away from the hustle and bustle of the city where guests can enjoy the laid back ambience and at the same time appreciate the beautiful historical interior of the house itself.

name: Renaissance Kuala Lumpur Hotel
description: Depicted as an urban resort in the heart of Kuala Lumpur City Center with intriguing offerings for a new sense of the destination. Renaissance Kuala Lumpur Hotel and Convention Centre invites guests to discover authentic experiences that will immerse them in the neighborhood's DNA. Our hotel in Kuala Lumpur features 406 redesigned guest rooms comprising themed family suites and extensive family-friendly facilities ranging from one of the largest pools in the city with water slides to an expansive outdoor play area. Enjoy spontaneous evenings at R Bar with its locally-inspired Bar Ritual experience or celebrate important milestones in one of the many design-led event spaces at the hotel's integrated convention center. From business to leisure Renaissance Kuala Lumpur Hotel and Convention Centre has it all.

name: One World Hotel Petaling Jaya
description: One World Hotel is a luxurious 5-star hotel located in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia. One World Hotel is ideally situated in the vibrant heart of Petaling Jaya, just 12 kilometers from Kuala Lumpur City Centre. The hotel offers direct access to the Bandar Utama MRT station, ensuring convenient city exploration for guests. With 452 rooms and suites, the accommodation options are diverse, including Superior Rooms, Deluxe Rooms, Executive Deluxe Rooms, Junior Suites, and Executive Suites, along with a specially designed superior room for guests with disabilities. Each room is equipped with top-notch amenities, from 50” LED televisions and complimentary wireless internet access to spacious bathrooms with bathtubs, coffee and tea making facilities, and personal safes, providing a comfortable and convenient stay. To view more packages, kindly WhatsApp +60163391027

name: Atlantic Grand Ballroom
description: Come and experience a modern Chinese Wedding at the Atlantic Grand Ballroom (food by Unique Seafood Group). Nestled within the prestigious Tropicana Golf & Country Resort, discover an exquisite wedding venue where every detail is designed for flawless celebrations. Ascend the Instagrammable staircase, a prelude that awaits in our full-scale ballroom. Envision your special day beneath soaring ceilings, illuminated by elegant chandeliers, with a prominent stage and state-of-the-art LED screens. Our venue comes with complimentary parking and buggy shuttle services ensuring effortless arrival for your guests. Prepare in style within our dedicated bridal makeup and dressing room. For intimate ROM ceremonies, the enchanting Spanish Courtyard offers a uniquely romantic setting.

name: Confetti KL
description: At Confetti, our promise is simple yet powerful: WE MAKE YOUR DAY. From the moment you step into our elegant venue, you and your guests will be immersed in an atmosphere of warmth, joy, and sophistication. Every corner of our space—from the grand banquet hall to the cozy private lounges and even Luxe Honeymoon Suite — all are thoughtfully designed to reflect your love story and elevate every moment of your celebration. Whether it’s the glow of romantic lighting, the seamless flow of your event, or the heartfelt service from our dedicated team, Confetti ensures that your wedding day is not just planned, but felt—magical, memorable, and completely yours.

name: Putrajaya Marriott Hotel
description:
Where your perfect occasion begins. We believe every event is a personal celebration, no matter the size. From cozy indoor gatherings to intimate outdoor moments, we create the ideal setting for your special day. Choose from our thoughtfully curated themes – Malay, Chinese, Indian, or Western – or let us craft something uniquely yours, designed with care and attention to detail.

For those seeking grandeur, our elegant ballroom offers a stunning space with a capacity of up to 1,200 guests, perfect for an extravagant wedding celebration. Whether you envision a lavish affair or a more intimate gathering, we are here to bring your dream day to life.

name: Le Meridien Putrajaya Wedding
description: Celebrate your love story in style at Le Méridien Putrajaya, a sophisticated setting designed to make every wedding unforgettable. Gracefully set in the vibrant IOI Resort City, this elegant venue blends contemporary design with thoughtful service. From grand ballroom to intimate gatherings, each space is crafted to elevate the occasion. Experienced wedding specialists are available to curate every detail, from bespoke menus to inspired decor, creating a celebration that reflects each couple’s unique journey.

name: Palm Garden Hotel Putrajaya
description: Palm Garden Hotel, Putrajaya is a premier wedding venue that combines elegance with versatility. It has a strategic location nearby to the Kuala Lumpur International airport and 25km away from Kuala Lumpur city centre. This pillarless ballroom boasts a spacious 6,781 sq. ft. area, accommodating up to 500 guests in a theater-style setup or 350 for a banquet-style reception. Its high ceilings and contemporary design provide a grand backdrop for weddings of all sizes. Equipped with state-of-the-art audio visual facilities and supported by Marriott Certified Wedding Planners, the ballroom ensures a seamless and memorable event.

name: Sofitel Kuala Lumpur Damansara
description:
Celebrate your once-in-a-lifetime moment in the timeless sophistication of Sofitel Kuala Lumpur Damansara. Nestled in the prestigious Damansara Heights, our luxurious ballroom features a striking curved design, dark wood accents, and a sculpted, avant-garde ceiling — creating a pillarless, breathtaking setting for your grand celebration. With the capacity to host up to 420 guests, every detail is thoughtfully curated to leave a lasting impression.

For more intimate weddings, Wan Chun Ting offers a refined space inspired by Imperial China, complete with intricate carved screens, a whimsical chandelier, and exquisite Cantonese cuisine. Perfect for receptions of up to 120 guests, it promises a truly bespoke dining experience.

At Sofitel Kuala Lumpur Damansara, your wedding dreams come alive with French elegance and heartfelt Malaysian hospitality. From lavish ballroom banquets to intimate cultural ceremonies, our dedicated wedding specialists are here to craft unforgettable moments tailored just for you.

name: Glenmarie Hotel & Golf Resort
description: Ensure your special day is as special as it can be by planning your dream wedding here with us! With over 350 acres of lush greenery, we offer the perfect backdrop as you tie the knot and exchange your vows! You can opt for a grand celebration at the Glenmarie Ballroom which comes with a charming garden area that’s perfect for an outdoor celebration. What’s more, our professional wedding planners can help ensure that the event goes off without a hitch by guiding you through the planning process every step of the way! With everything on offer, we make weddings in Selangor a celebration filled with joy and contentment!

name: PARKROYAL COLLECTION Kuala Lumpur
description:
PARKROYAL COLLECTION Kuala Lumpur is a welcome haven for the modern-day traveller who respects the environment. Gorgeous greenery, earthy tones and sleek wooden finishes within our hotel make it the perfect hideaway from skyscrapers, shopping malls and city streets teeming with activity.

There’s more: We’re committed to caring for the environment and your wellness which is why we’ve opted for biodegradable packaging, filtered drinking water in every guestroom and a variety of air-purifying plants and trees serving as natural humidifiers.

Straddling Jalan Sultan Ismail and Jalan Imbi, our eco-chic establishment boasts 527 rooms and suites, flexible meeting spaces and upscale F&B outlets that are guaranteed to elevate your dining experience. There’s even a whole floor devoted to holistic wellness, featuring an exquisite spa, modern gymnasium and fitness studio, and outdoor swimming pool.

Outside, Kuala Lumpur’s premier shopping and entertainment outlets await you. Inside, kick off your shoes, relax, unwind and refresh yourself.

name: The Ritz-Carlton
description: Discover the exclusive Ritz-Carlton, Kuala Lumpur, and experience a place where ancient rivers converge and a modern city beckons guests to explore the sights, sounds, and flavors of Malaysia. Located downtown in the Golden Triangle business district, our luxury hotel in Kuala Lumpur commands an enviable address in the heart of Malaysia's vibrant capital city, steps away from the upscale boutiques and skyscrapers. Guests at this distinctive five-star Kuala Lumpur hotel can enjoy convenient access to shopping, dining, and entertainment. Home to the magnificent Petronas Twin Towers which is a stroll away, Kuala Lumpur is also rich in culture and traditions. At The Ritz-Carlton, Kuala Lumpur, guests can indulge in soothing spa treatments, and award-winning cuisine or simply relax in the exceptional comfort of their rooms and take in the best that Kuala Lumpur has to offer.

name: Ciao Ristorante KL
description:
Open since 1991, Ciao Ristorante is an institution when it comes to Italian dining in Kuala Lumpur. If you are looking for a truly authentic Italian food experience, our 30 years of commitment will not disappoint you.

The restaurant resembles a rustic Italian farm house with a cosy garden and a small lake overlooking the golf course. The surrounding greenery and the ample parking facilities make us a unique venue for outdoor weddings and any other type of events. Spacious high-ceilinged rooms are suitable for indoor events too.

name: Intercontinental Hotel
description:
A jewel in the heart of Malaysia, InterContinental Kuala Lumpur offers one of the most sought-after locations in the heart of the city, making it an ideal urban retreat for both business and leisure travellers. The hotel is just steps away from the iconic Petronas Twin Towers & Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre, and within walking distance to two metro stations, as well as countless shopping and entertainment activities. Alternatively, you may enjoy our complimentary scheduled shuttle service to Pavilion KL and Suria KLCC shopping centre.

Choose to revel in comfort and luxury on Super King-sized beds and Super Single beds as well as luxury bath amenities in all the 473 spaciously designed rooms with earth-tone furnishings and state-of-the-art enhancements. Elevate your stay in our Suites and revel in a host of exclusive benefits that come with your Club InterContinental lounge access.

Take a dip in our outdoor pool, work out in our fitness centre and pamper yourself at our Peranakan-themed spa. Savour exquisite dining in style with a selection of restaurants, including the award-winning Tatsu Japanese Cuisine and Tao Chinese Cuisine, as well as Serena Brasserie, OneSixFive Lounge and Bentley's Pub.

Host meetings & events in our nine venues, and two pillarless high-ceiling ballrooms. We are your gateway to Kuala Lumpur.

name: Lumi Marketplace (LMP)
description:
LMP (Lumi Marketplace), Petaling Jaya's latest dining destination, offers unforgettable experiences. It is a vibrant destination for business, dining, and leisure.

Located at Lumi Tropicana, LMP is a mixed development project that offers residential, commercial, and lifestyle spaces. LMP features a variety of restaurants, cafes, and specialty stores that cater to different tastes and preferences. Whether you are looking for a casual bite, a fine dining experience, or a sweet treat, you can find it at LMP.

Looking for a unique and elegant venue for your next event? Look no further than LMP, the premier event space in the heart of Tropicana, Petaling Jaya. LMP offers a spacious and modern setting for any occasion, whether it's a wedding, a corporate meeting, a birthday party, or anything in between. LMP has everything you need to make your event a success, from catering and entertainment to to even team building, we got you covered.

name: Bayswater at KLCC
description:
Bayswater at KLCC is a premiere wedding and event space that offers a unique blend of elegance, versatility, and lush greenery — all within a rare 1-acre landscaped estate in the heart of Kuala Lumpur City Centre.

This one-of-a-kind venue features two distinct event spaces:
1. The Grand Pavilion @ BayswaterKLCC : a fully air-conditioned hall that accommodates up to 500 guests comfortably.
2. Gardens @ BayswaterKLCC : a semi-covered outdoor garden space that can host up to 200 guests, perfect for open-air ceremonies and intimate celebrations no matters rain or shine.

Whether you are planning a wedding, corporate dinner, product launch, prom night, or fashion runway, Bayswater at KLCC offers flexible layouts, beautiful surroundings, and a city-centre location to make your event truly memorable.

Why usually our client choose us?

- The distinctive concept that is with unique designs of the lighting installation and programmes within a garden in the city concept. It's perfect for smart casual to formal events!
 - The flexibilities of tables layout, product presentation showcase and even customised agenda and wedding setup.
- Conveniency! Its just 10 mins from Suria KLCC, surrounded with ample choices of hotels and airbnb for oversea and outstation guests!
- Valet Service on Point! or even ample parking space that a landed event venue in the city could have, we got you covered!
- We are a facilities group that owns different venue, and all venues are design and build for celebration. -Trusted team please look up for our google review~

name: The Luna Grand Ballroom Kuala Lumpur
description:
The Luna Grand Ballroom is a Modern Lifestyle Event Venue by the name itself, just like the moon, a gorgeous galactic entity in the mysterious space that can accommodate up to 400 pax.

The venue has floor-to-ceiling glass windows that offer a stunning 180° view of the KL City skyline and TRX view, making it a beautiful setting for weddings, corporate events, product launches, and private celebrations — day or night.

name: Ukay Hills - Private Event Estate & Lifestyle Suites
description:
The First & Only Resort-Style Event Venue In Kuala Lumpur - Ukay Hills!

Looking for a venue as magical and resort-feels as your Pinterest mood board like how you held a wedding in Italy but in Malaysia? 😍
@ukayhills_eventestate_suites is the newest gem in Kuala Lumpur, where dream weddings, corporate events and unforgettable celebrations come to life!
.

💫 A resort-style private event estate in KL — perfect for grand weddings, stylish parties, and everything in between.
.
✨ Explore their one-of-a-kind brand new celebration concept spaces:
🎊 Estate Grand Ballroom – Iconic Simply Stunning! glass architecture that fits up to 550 guests. Think show-stopping moments!
🎊 The Pandora – An Intimate Dreamy White Glass House, ideal for 150 - 200 guests.
🎊 The Centerpiece – A charming, expressive space for 100 guests who love to entertain in style.
👑 VIP Dining Room – For those who expect a little (or a lot) more. Pure intimate moments!
🛌 Lifestyle Suites – Wind down and stay the night in comfort after the celebration or a staycation style of city getaway into the hills!

💃 Ukay Hills is your all-in-one resort-style destination for weddings, events, and stays.

📍 Jalan Kelab Ukay Utama, Bukit Antarabangsa, 68000 Ampang, Selangor
📞 +6010-256 5618

name: The Grey Box (GMBB)
description:
The Grey Box is a dynamic event hall with an impressive 7-meter ceiling height, making it an exceptional choice for a variety of events, including launches, fashion shows, private gatherings, seminars, and conferences. This expansive 4,750 sqft space, which includes front-of-house and backstage areas, offers a bright, creative environment that adapts to your needs.

Versatile and Creative: The Grey Box features wall lines perfect for art exhibitions, and is seamlessly connected to the White Box and practice suites. Whether you’re hosting an art exhibit, a music performance, or a community bazaar, this versatile venue provides the flexibility to accommodate diverse events.

Connected and Collaborative: Located in the vibrant GMBB, a creative community mall in Bukit Bintang, The Grey Box is part of an enterprising hub that values collaboration and connection. GMBB fosters a creative ecosystem, partnering with artists, artisans, and the public to create meaningful and impactful experiences.

At The Grey Box, we believe in doing #MoreTogether, creating a space that inspires and supports your vision, whether it’s for a corporate event, creative showcase, or community gathering.

name: RAMA V
description:
Rama V first opened its doors in 1995, inviting diners into a hidden sanctuary away from Kuala Lumpur’s hustle and bustle. Nestled within a stand-alone bungalow, Rama V offers an experience that is both timeless and unforgettable.

At Rama V, the timeless traditions of Thai cuisine are seamlessly intertwined with the elegance of the modern world. The restaurant prides itself on delivering affordable Thai cuisine in a classic yet contemporary setting. This venue is perfect for intimate events, especially with the addition of the newly launched Fa-Ying Garden, providing ample space for outdoor ROM ceremonies, product launches, and other outdoor activations.

name: Maison Eleven - Lifestyle Event Venue
description:
Maison Eleven is a Modern French Lifestyle Event Venue located in a 4-star hotel, linked with Setia City Mall in the heart of Setia City Center. Maison Eleven captures the essences of modern luxury, with a 180 degree skyline view of Setia Alam's skyline through the expansive window view. 

Designed to accommodate up to 250pax guest for one time seated and can fit up to 500pax for come and go style, Maison Eleven offers a versatile space that can be tailored to suit the unique vision of each couple Whether you envision an intimate gathering or a lavish affair, Maison Eleven provides the perfect canvas for your dream wedding.

name: M World Hotel Petaling Jaya
description:
M World Hotel is a newly opened modern luxury hotel located in the heart of Petaling Jaya, next to the Bandar Utama MRT station and connected via 5-10 minutes covered walkway to 1 Utama Shopping Centre, Malaysia’s largest shopping mall and one of the largest in the world. Our front desk is ready to help you check-in for your stay, or you can opt for a contactless service via our Self Check-In / Check-Out Kiosk at the lobby. With 610 hotel rooms, catering to business, family and leisure guests, the hotel offers a
contemporary and homely experience with curated design and furnishings that will make each guests’ stay memorable and comforting.
M World Hotel offers an array of tantalising dining options – Chek’s Coffee House, Poolside Bar & SkyDeck Rooftop Dining – and state-of-the-art facilities including a Saltwater Infinity Pool on the 15th floor overlooking the city skyline, Kiddies Club, Beauty & Wellness Centre and a fully-equipped 24 hours gym – CHXpress Fitness 24/7. Our pillarless Ballrooms and 11 Function Rooms are customizable and suitable for events of all sizes – conferences, meetings, weddings and more. Whether on a business trip or a city break, discover a lifestyle of modern luxury, curated for the new generation, here at M World Hotel.

name: Pullman KLCC Hotel
description: Imagine a wedding reception in one of the elegant event rooms, or toasting with honoured guests in the opulent Pullman Grand Ballroom. Pullman turns that once-in-a-lifetime dream day into reality. Tie the knot in an unforgettable luxury wedding reception at the Pullman Kuala Lumpur City Centre Hotel & Residences. From traditional ceremonies to modern celebrations, sit back and relax in our wedding packages that turn your dreams into reality.

name: Eastin Hotel
description: An Urban Oasis Work, play, dine and make yourself at home. We bring together upscale comfort and a serene environment to help you recharge and relax. Situated in the heart of Malaysia’s pulsating commercial district, the hotel is the ‘Hub in Petaling Jaya’ for lifestyle and business. Easily accessible through Mass Rapid Transit (MRT), only a 5-minute walk from the hotel lobby making it convenient to explore. Business or pleasure, let your Malaysian experience begin.

name: Holiday Inn Sepang
description:
Welcome to Holiday Inn Sepang - Airport! We're thrilled to have you as our guest in the charming neighbourhood of Kota Warisan. Our contemporary hotel design reflects the modern and vibrant atmosphere of the area, offering a stylish and comfortable retreat during your visit. With 253 well-appointed guest rooms, including a luxurious presidential suite and family-friendly accommodations, we create a warm and welcoming atmosphere for all our guests. Our prime location offers easy access to Kuala Lumpur International Airport, as well as Putrajaya and Cyber City.

At Holiday Inn Sepang, our attentive and caring staff are here to make your stay exceptional. Whether you're travelling with your family, enjoying a leisure getaway, or visiting for business. Indulge in delightful dining experiences at The Garden Café or Pitstop, where our culinary offerings are sure to satisfy every taste. Keep fit at our well-equipped gym or take a refreshing dip in our pool. Additionally, we provide a convenient shuttle service for airport transportation needs.

Get ready to experience the renowned Holiday Inn service that has made us a trusted choice for travellers worldwide. We look forward to providing you with a memorable stay filled with comfort, convenience, and warm hospitality.

name: ELSE Kuala Lumpur
description: Else is Kuala Lumpur’s latest hotel destination. Globally-connected, locally-rooted, Else looks to be a beacon for the burgeoning cultural scene in downtown Kuala Lumpur. Providing mindful hospitality to serve the conscious traveller, facilitating deeper and more meaningful connections through curated experiences and content.

name: WG Glassbox Cyberjaya
description:
WG Glassbox in Cyberjaya is a contemporary and versatile event space, ideal for business meetings, workshops, and intimate gatherings.
This sleek, glass-walled venue is flooded with natural light, creating a bright and professional atmosphere that enhances any occasion. The space is equipped with state-of-the-art facilities, including high-speed WiFi, advanced audiovisual equipment, and customizable seating arrangements, ensuring it can adapt seamlessly to various event types.
Conveniently located in the heart of Cyberjaya, WG Glassbox offers easy access to ample parking and nearby amenities, making it the perfect choice for both corporate and social events.

name: Glasshouse at Seputeh
description:
Put your company values in to action with a company event. Whether you are planning for an annual awards ceremony and dinner, a summer picnic, or a holiday party, it can be more than letting loose and having a good time. Gather your employees and create a successful company event that promotes company culture, strengthen teamwork, boost creativity and raise employee morales.  
Award ceremonies celebrates the effort employees put into creating a successful business.  A great way to celebrate the successes of individual employees, teams, and the company.
Team building bring together work mates of all levels from different departments at the company. Employees can meet colleagues or customers in person to make real connections. A more relaxed environment sets an effective networking atmosphere where you are at ease to make more meaningful relations.
Setting up in a unique space gives employees a change to think outside the box, promoting creativity. Taking a break from work for a company event allows the team to recharge and get fresh ideas
Celebrations lead to a boost in employee morales and tie into the company’s culture to keep employees motivated and productive. A productive workforce drives the success of all companies from large organisations to small start-ups. With its versatile layout and transformational ambience, the Glasshouse at Seputeh venue ensures a smooth transition from boardroom and seminars to casual breakout sessions to memorable dinners and even after dinner parties. Glasshouse at Seputeh welcomes you to throw a great corporate event!

name: Colony @ The MET
description: Colony’s wedding venue in KL features breathtaking views and vibrant greenery, setting the stage for a truly memorable celebration. Exchange vows in the captivating Glass Box, where towering windows and a draped fabric ceiling create an airy, romantic ambiance. Or celebrate beneath the stars at the Rooftop Terrace, a peaceful garden hideaway above the bustling city. Whether you're planning a cozy ceremony or a lavish affair, every wedding here is crafted with elegance, charm, and personal flair.

name: Mandarin Oriental Kuala Lumpur
description: Nestled in the heart of Kuala Lumpur beside the iconic Petronas Twin Towers, the five-star Mandarin Oriental Hotel stands as one of the city’s most luxurious wedding destinations. Boasting two grand ballrooms and 16 versatile function rooms—including the largest pillarless ballroom in KL—it offers everything needed for an opulent celebration. The hotel provides a seamless wedding experience, from pre-wedding pampering like massages and therapies, to expertly coordinated ceremonies and custom wedding cakes, all the way to post-wedding indulgence in the honeymoon suite.

name: Royale Chulan Kuala Lumpur
description: Royale Chulan Kuala Lumpur promises an unparalleled setting paired with impeccable service, creating the perfect backdrop for the wedding of your dreams. From the moment you step through its grand entrance, you’ll be enveloped in an atmosphere of timeless elegance and refined sophistication. Whether you envision a lavish ballroom celebration or an intimate gathering, the hotel’s versatile event spaces, exquisite culinary offerings, and dedicated wedding specialists work in harmony to bring every detail to life. With a strong commitment to excellence and personalized care, Royale Chulan Kuala Lumpur ensures that your special day unfolds seamlessly, leaving you and your guests with cherished memories of a truly remarkable and successful celebration.

name: Sheraton Imperial KL
description: Sheraton Imperial Kuala Lumpur is where timeless elegance meets modern sophistication, offering the perfect setting for an unforgettable wedding celebration. Nestled in the heart of the city, this iconic five-star hotel is a sanctuary of luxury, with grand architecture, opulent interiors, and impeccable service that elevate every moment of your special day.

name: Imperial Lexis Kuala Lumpur
description:
Step into a world of refined elegance, where city weddings are transformed into unforgettable celebrations. Nestled in the heart of Kuala Lumpur, Imperial Lexis seamlessly blends grandeur, sophistication, and breathtaking views to create the perfect setting for your special day. Located in the heart of Kuala Lumpur, our venue features a range of stunning spaces designed to suit every couple’s unique vision, from intimate affairs to grand celebrations.

Imagine exchanging vows in a world-class venue adorned with opulent décor and surrounded by the beautiful city skyline. Whether an intimate affair or a lavish gathering, our dedicated wedding specialists will bring your vision to life, ensuring a seamless and extraordinary experience.

name: Boathouse By The Lake
description: Boathouse by the Lake—fondly known as Ampang Boathouse—effortlessly weaves timeless colonial elegance with contemporary luxury and inspired design, creating the perfect stage for your love story to unfold. Surrounded by lush greenery and graced with striking architecture and a chic, romantic ambiance, this enchanting venue sets the scene for unforgettable “I dos” and cherished memories that last a lifetime.

name: Sangkot Place
description: Nestled in the lush greenery of Hulu Langat, Sangkot offers two enchanting outdoor venues—Sangkot The Garden Event Place and Sangkot Tree—perfect for couples who dream of saying “I do” surrounded by the serenity of nature. Sangkot The Garden Event Place welcomes up to 300 seated guests amidst charming garden landscapes, while just a kilometer away, Sangkot Tree provides a grand, open-air setting for up to 600 seated guests. Both venues promise a magical alfresco wedding experience, where nature’s beauty creates an unforgettable backdrop for your most cherished day.

name: Changkat Telang 18
description: The Pavilion at Telang 18 radiates rustic charm and timeless elegance, providing a breathtaking backdrop for your once-in-a-lifetime celebration. Bathed in natural light through grand floor-to-ceiling windows that open onto lush, manicured lawns, it effortlessly fuses the serenity of nature with the comfort of an indoor venue—promising a dreamy, open-air wedding experience where romance lingers in every moment.

name: Forest Valley Hall
description: Renowned as one of Selangor’s most sought-after wedding venues, Forest Valley Hall offers a spectacular glasshouse setting nestled within the enchanting urban forest of Mahkota Cheras. Surrounded by lush, tropical greenery, its floor-to-ceiling glass panels reveal breathtaking views of the rainforest, creating a truly magical atmosphere for your celebration. The venue a picturesque outdoor garden space for romantic ceremonies. Complete with fairy-tale décor and ample parking, it promises the perfect backdrop for your dream wedding.

name: Ginger KL
description: Ginger’s stunning glasshouse setting offers the perfect backdrop for a sophisticated wedding celebration. With its enchanting hanging lights, soaring glass panels, and an elegant bar, the space exudes effortless charm and upscale glamour—setting the stage for a chic and unforgettable occasion for you and your guests.

name: Lantera Venue
description: located in the heart of Shah Alam, the Terrace at Lantera offers a charming and versatile space for weddings of all styles—be it a rustic, bohemian, garden-inspired celebration or an elegant traditional Malay affair. Ideal for both engagement ceremonies and solemnizations, this venue sets the stage for a truly romantic and unforgettable celebration.

name: Tamarind Springs
description: Tamarind Springs offers an enchanting escape for your dream wedding—a hidden gem in KL where nature’s splendor sets the stage for your special day. Exchange vows amidst lush gardens, serene walkways, and tranquil ponds, embraced by treetop views and timeless stone-carved statues. With its captivating blend of Asian elegance and natural beauty, Tamarind Springs is truly KL’s most unforgettable wedding destination.

name: The Acres Resort
description: The Acres Resort is a captivating 8-acre eco-sanctuary—offering the perfect backdrop for a destination-style wedding. Enveloped by lush greenery and serenaded by cool mountain breezes. At its heart lies a beautifully manicured lawn beside the main building, opening to sweeping mountain views—an idyllic setting for a magical garden ceremony embraced by nature’s quiet grandeur.

name: Tanarimba Janda Baik
description: The award-winning Visitor Centre at Tanarimba is the heart of most wedding celebrations—a stunning architectural masterpiece crafted from timber that harmoniously blends with the natural beauty that surrounds it. Designed to seat 250 guests with a total capacity of up to 500, this grand space features soaring timber columns and a romantic glow from cascading fairy lights, creating an enchanting setting that’s perfect for your unforgettable “I do.”

name: Club 360, Setia Ecohill, Semenyih
description: Sapphire Hall is an elegant event venue located on Level 3 of Club 360, Setia EcoHill, Semenyih. Designed for versatility and style, the hall can accommodate up to 30 banquet tables (approx. 240 guests), making it ideal for weddings, corporate functions, and private celebrations. Featuring modern interiors, customizable layouts, and access to a rooftop lounge with scenic views, the hall offers a premium setting within a full-service clubhouse. Guests also enjoy access to Club 360’s lifestyle facilities, including a gym, pool, and sports courts—creating a complete and memorable event experience in a vibrant, eco-inspired township.

name: Grand Ballroom @ LakePoint Club, Setia AlamImpian
description: Located within the serene LakePoint Complex, the Grand Ballroom offers a spacious and elegant venue ideal for weddings, corporate events, and grand celebrations. With a capacity of up to 1,000 guests, the ballroom features floor-to-ceiling glass panels overlooking a scenic lake and musical fountain. Modern facilities include AV systems, stage setup, VIP suites, and ample parking. Surrounded by a 31-acre park and full clubhouse amenities, it provides a luxurious and memorable event experience in a picturesque lakeside setting.

name: Camellia Hall, Canopy Club @ Setia Eco Park, Setia Alam
description: Camellia Hall is a versatile and air-conditioned event space within Canopy Club, Setia Eco Park. Featuring three adjoining halls that can be combined, it accommodates up to 220 guests—ideal for weddings, seminars, birthdays, and corporate events. The hall is equipped with a full AV system, projectors, banquet tables, and flexible seating arrangements. Located in a premium clubhouse with indoor and outdoor amenities, it offers both functionality and elegance in a serene, gated environment.

name: Kebun Rimba Private Estate
description: Kebun Rimba Private Estate, a rustic villa retreat nestled in the lush Janda Baik rainforest. Offering unique accommodations and versatile indoor and outdoor venues, it’s perfect for weddings, events, and private celebrations in nature. A rustic villa retreat nestled in the lush Janda Baik rainforest. Offering unique accommodations and versatile indoor and outdoor venues, it’s perfect for weddings, events, and private celebrations in nature. Offering unique accommodations and versatile indoor and outdoor venues, it’s perfect for weddings, events, and private celebrations in nature.

name: Meliá Kuala Lumpur
description: Meliá Kuala Lumpur offers an unrivalled location in the heart of the city, where a passion for impeccable service meets the rich essence of local culture. It’s a setting where cosmopolitan elegance and heartfelt hospitality come together—perfect for a wedding celebration that’s truly unforgettable.

name: Le Meridien Petaling Jaya
description: Nestled amidst charming residential neighbourhoods in West Kuala Lumpur, Le Méridien Petaling Jaya offers a serene yet accessible escape for your dream wedding. Perfectly positioned along a major highway that links the greater Klang Valley to Petaling Jaya City, it ensures easy arrival for all your loved ones. At the heart of your celebration, the pillar-free Grand Ballroom awaits—an opulent space with soaring ceilings and exquisite lighting that bathes the room in a soft, romantic glow, setting the perfect stage for an unforgettable “I do.”

name: Hilton Petaling Jaya
description: If convenience and elegance are at the top of your wedding wishlist, Hilton Petaling Jaya is the perfect choice. Ideally nestled in the heart of Petaling Jaya New Town, this iconic landmark along the Federal Highway offers effortless access from both Kuala Lumpur and Subang Jaya. From the moment you arrive, be captivated by the hotel's stylish resort-inspired interiors—an enchanting blend of timeless sophistication and modern charm that promises to leave you and your guests breathless as you step into your unforgettable celebration.

name: Templer's Ballroom @ Setia Eco Templer, Rawang
description:
Located amidst lush greenery in Setia Eco Templer, Rawang, Templer’s Ballroom offers a grand, pillar-free event space ideal for weddings, corporate functions, and cultural celebrations. The ballroom features high ceilings, elegant chandeliers, and a luxurious interior that blends modern sophistication with natural surroundings.

Capacity: Up to 600 guests (banquet) or 800 guests (theatre-style)

Layout: Divisible into two smaller ballrooms; includes a spacious pre-function foyer

Facilities: AV system, stage, bridal/VIP rooms, cocktail tables, registration counter

Ambience: Classic and refined with dark wood accents, red carpet, and natural light

Accessibility: ~20 km from KL, easily accessible via major highways

Amenities: On-site parking (300+ bays), swimming pool, gym, mini park (via Templer Club)

Templer’s Ballroom is a versatile, scenic venue perfect for those seeking a tranquil yet elegant event setting near the city.

name: Urban Park Hall
description: Urban Park Hall @ LKSA is a modern and spacious event venue in Alam Impian, Shah Alam. Featuring contemporary design, ample parking, and easy accessibility, it’s an ideal choice for weddings, corporate events, and special occasions, accommodating up to 600 (seated guests) or up to 1,000 guests in style and comfort.

name: Ampang Glasshouse
description:
At Ampang Glasshouse, every celebration is more than just an event, it’s a story waiting to unfold. With the stunning Main Hall, the cozy charm of The Cave, and the peaceful tranquility of the Poolside Garden, each space is designed to hold not just moments, but precious memories that will stay with you forever.

Whether it’s a wedding brimming with love, a dinner filled with laughter, or a gathering that marks a new chapter, every corner here is thoughtfully designed to bring your dreams to life. At Ampang Glasshouse, we don’t just provide a venue; we create an experience. True to our slogan: Design for Your Celebration.

We’ve had the honor of hosting countless international clients at Ampang Glasshouse, each celebrating their special moments with us. From intimate weddings to grand corporate events, we’ve crafted unforgettable experiences for guests from all corners of the world. Every event is personalized, ensuring every detail reflects the unique vision and dreams of our clients. It brings us immense joy to create moments that will be treasured forever, no matter where our clients come from.

name: Luminare Event Hall
description:
Welcome to Luminare Event Hall, a versatile and elegant venue designed to host unforgettable celebrations. Located in Damansara Perdana, our venue offers a perfect blend of sophistication, nature, and flexibility , ideal for weddings, corporate events, private functions, and special occasions of all kinds.

Luminare features four unique spaces, each with its own character and charm, allowing clients to customize their event experience according to their vision and guest capacity. Whether you’re planning an intimate gathering or a grand celebration, Luminare provides the perfect setting to make it happen.

name: A-Park Puchong
description: At A-Park Puchong we help you host your very own event to remember. From garden weddings to corporate gatherings, our team understands that hosting any event can be daunting – every detail leading to it, to managing the event on the day itself.

name: Astana at Bamboo Hills
description: Astana at Bamboo Hills is a premium, bespoke event venue just minutes from Kuala Lumpur’s city centre. Seamlessly pairs the elegance of the hall with the distinctive allure of the glasshouse, it provides a sophisticated atmosphere for every event. Managed by Connexion Conference & Event Centre (CCEC), Astana prioritises unforgettable experiences for any occasion.

name: G Glasshouse Klang
description: A premium event space for unforgettable celebrations. Spacious, elegant, and highly customizable perfect for weddings, corporate events, and private parties. Photo ready ambience, great facilities, and a welcoming experience for every guest.

name: Element Kuala Lumpur
description: Stay in your element at Element Kuala Lumpur, a welcoming family-friendly hotel where balance and comfort come naturally—whether you're here for a night or an extended stay. Perched 900 feet above ground in the iconic Ilham Tower, we’re just minutes from KL’s top attractions, including Suria KLCC, Pavilion Kuala Lumpur, and the KL Convention Center. As a Green Building Index-certified hotel, we’re proud to offer eco-friendly stays, thoughtful amenities, and warm, award-winning service. Take in sweeping views of the KLCC skyline from our light-filled lobby, or enjoy fresh Western fusion flavors and handcrafted cocktails at TRACE Restaurant & Bar. Host events with ease in our modern spaces, complete with expert planners and custom menus.

name: Chucasa Janda Baik
description: Nestled in the heart of Janda Baik, Chucasa offers a truly enchanting wedding in nature, surrounded by a natural pool, flowing stream, and tranquil lake. Embraced by lush greenery, the space feels intimate, peaceful, and romantic.  Couples can exchange vows beneath the elegant Pavilion or at the scenic Hilltop Garden with panoramic views, where nature becomes the perfect backdrop for your celebration. This is where love meets the beauty of the outdoors, creating timeless moments in a setting designed for unforgettable beginnings. Beyond weddings, Chucasa is also ideal for other events, from intimate celebrations to private gatherings, making it a versatile destination set within the beauty of the outdoors.

name: Connexion Conference & Event Centre (CCEC)
